body:
internal/mailinglist copied verbatim from IDUNA (zero cross-imports, real clean port). internal/http/handlers/mailinglist.go needed only its iduna/... import paths rewritten. Brings S245-01/02/03 along in one pass since all three were already real, tested code. Generalized: no hardcoded AllowOrigin/per-product MailchimpLists (the real EINHORN-specific parts), a tenant sets MAILING_LIST_ALLOW_ORIGIN instead. go build/test ./... clean (GOWORK=off), live-verified booting the real binary against a fresh SQLite file -- both new permissions present after migration, /health OK. Commit f19382f. Unblocks S245-04's settings page.

⚓ ☃
